gloss: to sink; to set (sun); to be submerged; to die; to pass away (formal/literary); to be absorbed in; to be immersed in

definitions.gloss: to sink; to set (sun); to be submerged
to be absorbed in; to be immersed in

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}が{水平線|すいへいせん}に{没|ぼっ}した。
examples.english: The sun sank below the horizon.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}が{嵐|あらし}で{海|うみ}に{没|ぼっ}した。
examples.english: The ship sank in the storm.

examples.japanese: {夕日|ゆうひ}が{山|やま}の{向|む}こうに{没|ぼっ}していく{光景|こうけい}は{息|いき}を{飲|の}むほど{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: The scene of the setting sun sinking behind the mountains was breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{昨年|さくねん}{没|ぼっ}した。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away last year.

examples.japanese: その{作家|さっか}は1950{年|ねん}に{没|ぼっ}している。
{没年|ぼつねん}は{不明|ふめい}とされている。
examples.english: The year of death is said to be unknown.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{研究|けんきゅう}に{没頭|ぼっとう}している。
examples.english: He is absorbed in his research.

examples.japanese: {趣味|しゅみ}に{没頭|ぼっとう}するあまり、{時間|じかん}を{忘|わす}れてしまった。
examples.english: I was so absorbed in my hobby that I lost track of time.

examples.japanese: {小説|しょうせつ}の{世界|せかい}に{没入|ぼつにゅう}して、{周|まわ}りの{声|こえ}が{聞|き}こえなくなった。
examples.english: I became so immersed in the world of the novel that I stopped hearing the voices around me.

notes:
A literary verb with multiple related meanings, all sharing the core idea of something sinking or disappearing. The character {没|ぼつ} means "to sink" or "to disappear."

USAGE:
- Sense 1 is mainly literary; in everyday speech, {沈|しず}む is more common
- Sense 2 is the formal/biographical way to say someone died; common in historical writing
- Sense 3 appears most often in the compound {没頭|ぼっとう}する (to be absorbed in) and {没入|ぼつにゅう}する (to be immersed in)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日|ひ}が{没|ぼっ}する: the sun sets
- {没年|ぼつねん}: year of death
- {没後|ぼつご}: after someone's death; posthumously
- {没頭|ぼっとう}する: to be absorbed in
- {没入|ぼつにゅう}する: to be immersed in
- {埋没|まいぼつ}する: to be buried; to fall into obscurity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {沈|しず}む: to sink — the everyday equivalent for sense 1
- {亡|な}くなる: to pass away — the standard euphemism for death
- {没頭|ぼっとう}する: to be absorbed in — the most common compound using {没|ぼつ}
